bootstrapPolicy: Use Slack Remote Bridge for bootstrap whenever the connector is available and a live CLAW_RPC_V1 ping succeeds. Use RDC for bootstrap only when Slack is unavailable or degraded, or when a required bootstrap method is unsupported by the Bridge.
quotaPolicy: Remote Desktop Commander is quota-constrained and must not be used for routine bootstrap or normal work when Slack can complete the request.
fallbackRules: Use RDC only when Slack connector is unavailable, Slack/Bridge is degraded, or the required method cannot complete through Slack.
Routine bootstrap uses Slack after a live ping; RDC bootstrap is break-glass only.
Record the fallback reason before substantive fallback execution.
Never execute the same mutation independently on both transports; query the same requestId before retry.
Restore Slack primary only after a fresh benign E2E ping succeeds.
